([[Hamilton Township, Mercer County, New Jersey|Hamilton, New Jersey]]) | college = [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] (2015–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2015 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2015]]) }} '''Malachi Richardson''' (born January 5, 1996) is an American [[basketball]] player. He recently ended his [[college basketball]] career for the [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse Orange]] by declaring himself eligible for the [[2016 NBA draft]]. Richardson attended [[Trenton Catholic Academy]] his freshman year, then spent his sophomore year at [[Roselle Catholic High School]] before returning to Trenton Catholic Academy for his junior and senior years, to team back up with coach Fred Falchi who returned from retirement to coach. In his high school career ar [[Trenton Catholic Academy]][http://www.nj.com/hssports/blog/boysbasketball/index.ssf/2013/08/boys_basketball_malachi_richardson_leaves_roselle_catholic_returns_to_trenton_catholic.html Boys Basketball: Malachi Richardson leaves Roselle Catholic, returns to Trenton Catholic] Malachi scored a total 1245 points averaging 9.3 in his freshman, 19.2 points in his junior year and 18.7 in his senior year of highschool. At [[Roselle Catholic High School|Roselle Catholic]] in his sophomore year Malachi would score 429 averaging 15.3 points a game, he would also win [[NJSIAA]]'s [[Tournament of Champions (NJSIAA)|Tournament of Champions]] for boys basketball. As a freshman at [[Syracuse University]], Richardson averaged 13.4 points, 2.1 assists and 4.3 rebounds per game. After the season, he entered the [[2016 NBA Draft]], but did not initially sign with an agent.[http://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/index.ssf/2016/04/malachi_richardson_entering_name_in_the_nba_draft_not_sign_with_agent.html Malachi Richardson entering name in the NBA Draft, not signing with agent][http://www.trentonian.com/article/TT/20160418/SPORTS/160419721 Syracuse freshman Malachi Richardson enters NBA draft, won’t sign with agent] During the 2016 NBA combine, Richardson wound up signing with an agent.{{cite news|last1=Goodman|first1=Jeff|title=Malachi Richardson signs with agent, stays in NBA draft|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2016/story/_/id/15563589/malachi-richardson-signs-agent-return-syracuse-orange|accessdate=May 17, 2016|work=[[ESPN.com]]|date=May 16, 2016}} He'd be one of 59 college underclassmen that year to do so. Richardson is projected to be taken sometime in the first round, presumably somewhere in the Top 20.
